text:
ashwin: Kicked off phoenix13b (4-bit PTQ dynamic) to hosted canary last night. Quick FYI — seeing a couple of strange things on small prompts and embeddings. Anyone on call?

carmen: Saw immediate duplication on short date prompts. Example repro below, also rerank embed similarity drift vs fp16 baseline. :eyes:

carmen: ```
Input: "Invoice due Jan 5"
Model output (phoenix13b-4bit): "Invoice due Jan 5 Jan 5"
Expected (phoenix13b-fp16): "Invoice due Jan 5"
```

derek: Can you paste the minimal server log around that request? Need to see token ids and kvcache behavior.

carmen: Log snippet: ```
[2026-03-19T03:10:12Z] req id=rc-33 token_ids=[101, 545, 789, 12]
[2026-03-19T03:10:12Z] model=phoenix13b-4bit kvcache_hits=0 kvcache_misses=1
[2026-03-19T03:10:12Z] output_tokens=[101, 545, 789, 12, 545, 789]
```

maya: Running perf canary numbers now — confirmed: for <20 token responses p99 jumped from ~120ms to ~260ms after the 4-bit rollout. CPU scheduler shows sporadic spikes (threads waiting on fused-kernel).

ashwin: Huh. We used our PTQ profile that passed unit tests. Could be a kernel mismatch for kvcache read/write ordering under quantization. Also customers report slight embedding shifts so rerank scoring affected.

derek: Proposed immediate checklist:
- tokenizer/bytepair compare between fp16 vs quant (token ids + offsets)
- kvcache unit tests in quant mode (replay short prompt sequences)
- attention kernel sanity (fused vs fallback path)
- run embedding normalization sanity (post-quant scaling)
- run regen tests for short prompts across beam/greedy

qa-bot: Created ticket INFER-7423: "phoenix13b-4bit: short-prompt duplication + p99 perf regression + embed drift" and linked to canary runs.

deploy-bot: Canary update: phoenix13b-4bit rolled back to phoenix13b-fp16 at 2026-03-19T04:12Z per rollback-policy (rule: perf >2x p99).

carmen: After rollback latencies reverted to ~110ms p99. Duplication no longer reproduces on fp16. Embedding similarity: still seeing ~3% drop vs baseline in some rerank slices (longer contexts).

maya: Running an ablation to see if prefix_kv caching is introducing duplication under quantized decode. Hypothesis: quant kernel writes half-precision aligned offsets and the cache indexing gets doubled on short sequences.

ashwin: @derek please own until root cause confirmed. Add labels: regression, quant, high-priority. Also drop an immediate mitigation: disable prefix cache for 4-bit model on hosted until patch.

derek: I'll run local reproducer + perf trace (perf, nvprof, fused-kernel logs) and attach results here. ETA ~3h.

carmen: Also want a quick eval diff on our embedding cohort (search rerank test) — I can run comparisons and post graphs.

maya: Quick mitigation applied: prefix_cache=false for phoenix13b-4bit canary. Monitoring.

derek: Found mismatch in scale multiplier during post-quant linear out (small rounding error propagated into token selection probabilities). Fix candidate in branch fix/quant-out-scale. Running unit tests.

ashwin: Nice catch. After tests, let's run a micro-canary with the fix + prefix_cache enabled. If stable, we can re-run canary with perf instrumented.

carmen: Customer impact: a small set of users saw duplicated tokens and slightly worse rerank scores yesterday. We've notified CS and flagged for watch.

qa-bot: Added regression labels and postmortem template to INFER-7423.

deploy-bot: micro-canary scheduled: phoenix13b-4bit-fix-20260319 at 2026-03-19T07:40Z.

ashwin: Thanks team — keep updates here only. If anyone finds customer-facing repros, paste them. :thumbsup:
